title: Fix spelling of "GDExtension" in the Export Template Manager
rationale: Fork's export_template_manager.cpp has no _initialize_template_data/TemplateInfo/GDExtensions template text (that 4.7 template-data rework is absent), so the misspelled string does not exist to fix.

title: Fix a couple of issues when deleting presets in the export dialog
rationale: project_export.cpp _edit_preset early-return block (line 261-267) lacks export_warning->hide() and _delete_preset_confirm (line 794) is pre-fix; applies but must be sequenced with 118793 which also edits _delete_preset_confirm.

title: Fix export errors with non-resources
rationale: editor_export_platform.cpp export_project_files has the matching pre-fix _export_customize call (line 1646) and the `type` var (line 1458) the guard needs is in scope.

title: Fix export notifier.
rationale: Depends on the p_notify parameter added by 118787: fork's export_project virtual (editor_export_platform.h:347) and platform impls have no p_notify guard, so the ExportNotifier p_enabled rework has nothing to attach to.

title: Fix wrong path in `EditorExportPlugin._export_begin()` when zipping
rationale: Fork export code is at an earlier baseline: export_project virtual has no p_notify (editor_export_platform.h:347), there is no editor_export_platform.compat.inc, and platform zip paths differ; needs hand-adaptation of the whole notifier flow.

title: Fix wrong `beat_count` set in stream import when it's greater than previous `beat_max`
rationale: audio_stream_import_settings.cpp edit() has the matching pre-fix beats_edit->set_value(beats) at line 472 with no preceding set_max(99999).

title: Fix and improve the editor layout dialog
rationale: Already present: editor_node.cpp uses bool overridden_default_layout (line 7892/7903/7906) and set_save_mode_enabled (7925), and editor_layouts_dialog.cpp has _validate_name/EditorValidationPanel.

title: Fix bugs with editing enter key shortcuts
rationale: The enter/escape-to-confirm block it patches (Key::ENTER/_ok_pressed/current_key) is entirely absent from fork's input_event_configuration_dialog.cpp _set_event, so the fix depends on an absent feature.

title: Import: Fix generated collision preview
rationale: scene_import_settings.cpp _update_view_gizmos has the exact pre-fix find_children("collider_view", "MeshInstance3D") call at line 590.

title: Fix audio import dialog improperly reseting the "Master" bus
rationale: audio_stream_import_settings.cpp _stop() (line 278) calls _load_master_state() unconditionally and _on_finished() (line 288) does not call it, matching the pre-fix state.

title: Fix per-project overrides not working for language
rationale: editor_settings.cpp _set still fires setup_language directly (line 84) and notify_changes (2214)/check_changed_settings_in_group (1411) exist; applies but must use the fork's setting key interface/editor/editor_language (not the 4.7 .../localization/... path).

title: Fix `get_version()` fallback for Android
rationale: editor_export_preset.cpp get_version (line 603) has the _check_digits loop (line 612) unguarded by the EditorExportPlatformAndroid class check the PR adds.

title: Fix wrong disabled states for buttons in the export dialog
rationale: project_export.cpp _delete_preset_confirm (line 794) is pre-fix (unconditional button-disable before remove); applies, and must be sequenced before 119494 which further edits this function.

title: Fix `EditorScenePostImportPlugin::_get_internal_option_visibility()` having no effect
rationale: post_import_plugin_skeleton_rest_fixer.cpp get_internal_option_visibility still returns bool true at line 83 instead of Variant(); fork signature has the extra p_scene_import_type arg but the one-line return fix applies unchanged.

title: Fix `export_template_manager.cpp` compilation with `deprecated=no`
rationale: Targets _initialize_template_data and the VERSION_FULL_CONFIG->GODOT_VERSION_FULL_CONFIG rename; neither the function nor that version macro exists in fork's export_template_manager.cpp.

title: [iOS] Fix one-click deploy with Xcode 26.
rationale: Already present: editor_export_platform_apple_embedded.cpp _check_for_changes_poll_thread already passes false as the read_stderr arg to execute("xcrun", ...) at line 2433.

title: Fix some regressions with the build profile editor
rationale: Already present: editor_build_profile.cpp has the classes comment (line 239), unconditional cache.classes.push_back(E) (811), and the all_used_classes.has(class_name) guard in _detect_from_project (1022).

title: Fix crash caused by input configuration dialog
rationale: The crashing block (current_key->get_physical_keycode() inside the already-bound is_visible() branch) is absent from fork's input_event_configuration_dialog.cpp _set_event, so the guard fix has no target until that feature is ported.

title: Fix "Pack Project as Zip" not saving permissions and time.
rationale: Already present: editor_export_platform.cpp uses the fixed external_fa expression (lines 1941/1985) and project_zip_packer.cpp _zip_file already sets tmz_date/permissions via get_modified_time (line 75).

title: Fix compilation configuration editor not working
rationale: Already present: editor_build_profile.cpp _detect_from_project already has the corrected condition with !ClassDB::is_parent_class(...) at line 979.

title: Fix extracting materials from `.gltf` and `.blend` files throws error
rationale: resource_importer_scene.cpp _post_fix_node still has the pre-fix `if (!mat_id.is_empty() && extract_mat != 0)` at line 1601 lacking the p_material_data.has(mat_id) guard.

title: Fix incorrect index usage in path string construction in `PostImportPluginSkeletonRestFixer`
rationale: post_import_plugin_skeleton_rest_fixer.cpp internal_process still has the buggy names[i] (should be names[j]) at line 607.

title: Fix build profile generator always enabling 2D navigation
rationale: Already present: editor_build_profile.cpp build_option_classes already has the trailing comma after "NavigationObstacle2D" at line 248.

title: Fix detection of some features in Engine Compilation Configuration Editor
rationale: Already present: editor_build_profile.cpp constructor uses the correct BUILD_OPTION_WAYLAND/X11/D3D12 keys (lines 636/641/670) rather than the duplicated OPENXR/VULKAN inserts.

title: Fix editor colors reseting while the color chooser is still open
rationale: Already present: editor_settings_dialog.cpp has the no-arg _settings_property_edited() using get_changed_settings() (lines 67-68) connected to the settings_changed signal (line 1017).
